rules.description: Verify each input table generates at least one active StatVar.

params.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_svs FROM stats

rules.description: Verify 2018 life expectancy (ujtdaag), 2017-Q4 labor force (ulouknf), 2017 census/employment/graduates/infant mortality (behvqtc, bluhqme, lxoyale, mptocre, pqpump, szfufmb, zkjifzd, zpdksog), and 2016 education enrollment/teachers (txbrrac, wcssteb, wtxyghf) StatVars meet their expected MaxDate boundaries.

params.query: SELECT StatVar, CAST(MaxDate AS VARCHAR) AS MaxDate, is_ulouknf FROM (SELECT StatVar, MaxDate, MAX(CASE WHEN StatVar = 'UnemploymentRate_Person' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER () AS is_xovpotd, MAX(CASE WHEN StatVar = 'Count_Person_InLaborForce' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER () AS is_ulouknf FROM stats) WHERE NOT regexp_matches(StatVar, '^Count_(Bed_|CriminalIncidents$|Death$|Establishment_|HealthEstablishment_.*Hospital|Incident_|MedicalConditionIncident_)') AND StatVar != 'FertilityRate_Person_Female' AND NOT regexp_matches(StatVar, '_(HealthFacility|DoctorOccupation|NurseOccupation)$') AND is_xovpotd = 0
params.condition: CASE WHEN regexp_matches(StatVar, '^LifeExpectancy_Person_') THEN MaxDate >= '2018' WHEN is_ulouknf = 1 THEN MaxDate >= '2017-12' WHEN regexp_matches(StatVar, '^(Count_(Student|Teacher)_|dc/7hlfs8swh22v3$)') THEN MaxDate >= '2016' ELSE MaxDate >= '2017' END

rules.description: Verify 2014 health facilities/staff (cjczlcd), 2014 total fertility rate (viytqvf), and 2005-2014-09 socio-economic macro series (xovpotd) meet their expected MaxDate boundaries.

params.query: SELECT StatVar, CAST(MaxDate AS VARCHAR) AS MaxDate FROM (SELECT StatVar, MaxDate, MAX(CASE WHEN StatVar = 'UnemploymentRate_Person' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER () AS is_xovpotd FROM stats) WHERE StatVar = 'FertilityRate_Person_Female' OR regexp_matches(StatVar, '_(HealthFacility|DoctorOccupation|NurseOccupation)$') OR is_xovpotd = 1
params.condition: CASE WHEN StatVar IN ('Count_Person_CommoditySector', 'Count_Person_ProductiveSocialServicesSector') THEN MaxDate >= '2005' WHEN StatVar IN ('Count_Person', 'Count_Person_NotACitizen') THEN MaxDate >= '2011' WHEN regexp_matches(StatVar, '^(Amount_EconomicActivity_GrossDomesticProduction_|Count_Person_(Employed|Resident|Unemployed)$)') THEN MaxDate >= '2012' WHEN StatVar = 'FertilityRate_Person_Female' OR regexp_matches(StatVar, '_(HealthFacility|DoctorOccupation|NurseOccupation)$') THEN MaxDate >= '2014' ELSE MaxDate >= '2014-09' END

rules.description: Verify 2002-2011 health services, hospitals, beds, ambulance stations, youth centers, and traffic/medical incident series (actytif) meet their expected MaxDate boundaries.

params.query: SELECT StatVar, CAST(MaxDate AS VARCHAR) AS MaxDate FROM stats WHERE regexp_matches(StatVar, '^Count_(Bed_|CriminalIncidents$|Death$|Establishment_|HealthEstablishment_.*Hospital|Incident_|MedicalConditionIncident_)')
params.condition: CASE WHEN StatVar = 'Count_MedicalConditionIncident_SportsGamesAccidents' THEN MaxDate >= '2002' WHEN StatVar IN ('Count_Incident_Other_AccidentDamage', 'Count_MedicalConditionIncident_ScorpionOrSnakeBites') THEN MaxDate >= '2004' WHEN StatVar = 'Count_CriminalIncidents' THEN MaxDate >= '2008' WHEN regexp_matches(StatVar, '^Count_(Bed_|Establishment_SocialCareFacility$|HealthEstablishment_.*Hospital)') THEN MaxDate >= '2009' WHEN StatVar IN ('Count_Death', 'Count_Incident_AccidentDamage', 'Count_Incident_TrafficAccident') OR regexp_matches(StatVar, '^Count_(Incident_.*_(TrafficAccident|AccidentDamage)|MedicalConditionIncident_(Anaesthetics|Bleeding|Dislocation|Fracture|Hernia|InsectBites|LossOfConsciousness|Others|Suffocation|Wounds))$') THEN MaxDate >= '2010' ELSE MaxDate >= '2011' END

rules.description: Checks that deleted records do not exceed threshold (0.1%).
